newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk court cancels state property sell-off law.
newsitem.headline: Turk court cancels state property sell-off law.

text.p: Turkey's constitutional court on Thursday cancelled a law that would enable the government to sell state property, a court official told Reuters.
The law had been anticipated to bring in revenues of 300 trillion Turkish lira for the government as part of its measures to raise funds.
Turkey's Official Gazette had published the law on September 12, after which 113 deputies from two left-wing parties applied to the court for the law's cancellation.
State property sales were part of the government's first revenue-raising package announced in July.
